declarations.bibleVerseText: He himself bore our sins in his body on the cross, so that we might die to sins and live for righteousness; by his wounds you have been healed.

declarations.text: I cast every anxiety on God because He cares for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

declarations.text: I walk in humility and God pours abundant grace on me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God opposes the proud but shows favor to the humble.

declarations.text: My inheritance is imperishable and unfading, kept in heaven for me by the power of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And into an inheritance that can never perish, spoil or fade. This inheritance is kept in heaven for you.

declarations.text: I participate in the divine nature through His exceeding great promises.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Through these he has given us his very great and precious promises, so that through them you may participate in the divine nature.

declarations.text: God has given me everything I need for life and godliness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: His divine power has given us everything we need for a godly life through our knowledge of him.

declarations.text: My calling and election are secure — God has confirmed my place in His kingdom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, my brothers and sisters, make every effort to confirm your calling and election. For if you do these things, you will never stumble, and you will receive a rich welcome into the eternal kingdom of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: I grow in grace and in the knowledge of my Lord Jesus Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

declarations.text: God's timing is not my timing — one day with Him is as a thousand years.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But do not forget this one thing, dear friends: With the Lord a day is like a thousand years, and a thousand years are like a day.

declarations.text: God chose me on purpose, with love and a plan, before I was ever born.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we know, brothers and sisters loved by God, that he has chosen you.

declarations.text: God gives me joy that does not depend on my circumstances — I rejoice always.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Rejoice always, pray continually, give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: God sanctifies me completely in spirit, soul, and body and keeps me blameless.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May God himself, the God of peace, sanctify you through and through.

declarations.text: I am a child of light and a child of the day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you, brothers and sisters, are not in darkness so that this day should surprise you like a thief. You are all children of the light and children of the day. We do not belong to the night or to the darkness.

declarations.text: Christ is coming again, and I live every day in that glorious expectation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the Lord himself will come down from heaven, with a loud command, with the voice of the archangel and with the trumpet call of God, and the dead in Christ will rise first.

declarations.text: God is faithful — He strengthens me and guards me from every evil attack.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.

declarations.text: God establishes me firm in His truth and I am not tossed by every wind.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So then, brothers and sisters, stand firm and hold fast to the teachings we passed on to you, whether by word of mouth or by letter.

declarations.text: My heart is encouraged and established in every good word and work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May our Lord Jesus Christ himself and God our Father, who loved us and by his grace gave us eternal encouragement and good hope, encourage your hearts and strengthen you in every good deed and word.

declarations.text: The Lord directs my heart into His love and the steadfastness of Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the Lord direct your hearts into God's love and Christ's perseverance.

declarations.text: The grace and peace of God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ rest upon me always.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Grace and peace to you from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony; they did not love their lives so much as to shrink from death.
declarations.declaration: I overcome every enemy by the blood of the Lamb and the word of my testimony.

declarations.bibleVerseText: Be faithful, even to the point of death, and I will give you life as your victor's crown.
declarations.declaration: God promises me a victor's crown. I walk in faithfulness and I will not be afraid.

declarations.bibleVerseText: To the one who is victorious, I will give some of the hidden manna. I will also give that person a white stone with a new name written on it.
declarations.declaration: I am victorious in Christ. God has hidden treasure and a new name for me.

declarations.bibleVerseText: To the one who is victorious and does my will to the end, I will give authority over the nations.
declarations.declaration: I am victorious in Christ. God has given me real authority and purpose.

declarations.bibleVerseText: The one who is victorious will, like them, be dressed in white.
declarations.declaration: I am clothed in the righteousness of Christ. I am dressed in white before God.

declarations.bibleVerseText: The one who is victorious I will make a pillar in the temple of my God.
declarations.declaration: I am victorious in Christ. God makes me a strong pillar in His house.

declarations.bibleVerseText: To the one who is victorious, I will give the right to sit with me on my throne.
declarations.declaration: I am victorious in Christ and I sit with Him on His throne.

declarations.bibleVerseText: He who was seated on the throne said, 'I am making everything new!' Then he said, 'Write this down, for these words are trustworthy and true.'
declarations.declaration: God is making all things new. My life is being renewed by His faithful hands.

declarations.bibleVerseText: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
declarations.declaration: God will wipe every tear from my eyes. Sorrow does not get the final word.

declarations.bibleVerseText: These are the words of the Amen, the faithful and true witness, the ruler of God's creation.
declarations.declaration: Jesus is faithful and true. His word over my life stands forever and never fails.

declarations.text: I trust God with my whole heart and lean not on my own understanding.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.

declarations.text: The Lord makes my paths straight.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight.

declarations.text: God's wisdom is my greatest treasure, worth more than anything I own.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who find wisdom, those who gain understanding, for she is more profitable than silver and yields better returns than gold.

declarations.text: The Lord orders every step of my path and guides me into purpose.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In their hearts humans plan their course, but the Lord establishes their steps.

declarations.text: My heart overflows with God's life and power — it is well-protected and full of His goodness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Above all else, guard your heart, for everything you do flows from it.

declarations.text: My life shines brighter and brighter like the dawn — the path of the righteous grows more luminous every day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The path of the righteous is like the morning sun, shining ever brighter till the full light of day.

declarations.text: Everything I commit to God prospers and succeeds.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.

declarations.text: My gentle words bring peace and healing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

declarations.text: Honoring God with my life and firstfruits brings long life and abundant blessing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The fear of the Lord adds length to life, but the years of the wicked are cut short.

declarations.text: My value is not determined by the world but by the One who made me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She is more precious than rubies; nothing you desire can compare with her.

declarations.text: Wisdom and faithful instruction flow from my mouth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The lips of the wise spread knowledge, but the hearts of fools are not upright.

declarations.text: My relationships make me sharper and stronger.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another.

declarations.text: I commit my plans to God and He establishes them.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Many are the plans in a person's heart, but it is the Lord's purpose that prevails.

declarations.text: A good name and God's favor are worth more than great riches.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A good name is more desirable than great riches; to be esteemed is better than silver or gold.

declarations.text: God prospers the work of my hands.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Lazy hands make for poverty, but diligent hands bring wealth.

declarations.text: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth without painful toil or sorrow.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth, without painful toil for it.

declarations.text: My words carry the power of life and death.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The tongue has the power of life and death, and those who love it will eat its fruit.

declarations.text: I bring honor and blessing to my family.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A wife of noble character is her husband's crown, but a disgraceful wife is like decay in his bones.

declarations.text: I face the future with joy and confidence — I can laugh at the days to come.
declarations.bibleVerseText: She is clothed with strength and dignity; she can laugh at the days to come.

declarations.text: My family sees God's blessing in my life as a testimony of His faithfulness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Her children arise and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praises her.

declarations.text: God fills me with His wisdom and understanding.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who find wisdom, those who gain understanding, for she is more profitable than silver.

declarations.text: God's righteousness protects my path — I walk in His integrity and strength.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Righteousness guards the person of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

declarations.text: God's wisdom builds my life and my legacy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By wisdom a house is built, and through understanding it is established; through knowledge its rooms are filled with rare and beautiful treasures.

declarations.text: God gives me wisdom to guide my children in His ways.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Start children off on the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not turn from it.

declarations.text: My humility brings honor and blessing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall. Better to be lowly in spirit along with the oppressed than to share plunder with the proud.

declarations.text: The Lord's protection surrounds me completely — I am safe and covered in His care.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He will cover you with his feathers, and under his wings you will find refuge; his faithfulness will be your shield and rampart.

declarations.text: I dwell in the secret place of the Most High.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

declarations.text: The Lord is my impenetrable shield and faithful protector in everything.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you, Lord, are a shield around me, my glory, the One who lifts my head high.

declarations.text: Angels guard me in all my ways by God's divine command.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.

declarations.text: My fortress in God is unshakeable and provides perfect security always.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my rock, my fortress and my deliverer; my God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.

declarations.text: Divine strength flows through me right now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me. My heart leaps for joy, and with my song I praise him.

declarations.text: I am mighty in the Lord's power, not in my own ability.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You are awesome, O God, in your sanctuary; the God of Israel gives power and strength to his people. Praise be to God!

declarations.text: Mountains move at the faith God has placed in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth give way and the mountains fall into the heart of the sea, though its waters roar and foam and the mountains quake with their surging.

declarations.text: With God I can advance against any troop and scale any wall.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With your help I can advance against a troop; with my God I can scale a wall.

declarations.text: Victory is mine in every battle because my God has never lost a war.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May we shout for joy over your victory and lift up our banners in the name of our God.

declarations.text: Perfect peace guards my heart and mind — God keeps me in shalom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord gives strength to his people; the Lord blesses his people with peace.

declarations.text: I rest in divine tranquility — my soul is quiet, my heart is still.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Return to your rest, my soul, for the Lord has been good to you.

declarations.text: He leads me beside still waters and restores my soul daily.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters.

declarations.text: My sleep is sweet and peaceful — I lie down without fear.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.

declarations.text: The peace of God flows through every part of me — spirit, soul, and body.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But I have calmed and quieted myself, I am like a weaned child with its mother; like a weaned child I am content.

declarations.text: My cup overflows — God's goodness and mercy are so abundant they spill over onto everyone and everything around me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows.

declarations.text: I lack nothing — my Shepherd provides for every need, and His supply never runs dry.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The lions may grow weak and hungry, but those who seek the Lord lack no good thing.

declarations.text: God's divine provision meets every need I have.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I was young and now I am old, yet I have never seen the righteous forsaken or their children begging bread.

declarations.text: Goodness and mercy pursue me relentlessly all the days of my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.

declarations.text: Heaven's resources are available to me as an heir of the God who owns it all.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; the Lord bestows favor and honor; no good thing does he withhold from those whose walk is blameless.

declarations.text: Divine healing flows through me now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise the Lord, my soul, and forget not all his benefits who forgives all your sins and heals all your diseases.

declarations.text: Every cell in my body is touched by the healing power of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He sent out his word and healed them; he rescued them from the grave.

declarations.text: I am restored to wholeness — spirit, soul, and body.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Lord my God, I called to you for help, and you healed me.

declarations.text: My healing springs forth speedily — God's word over my body is producing results right now.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

declarations.text: My youth is renewed like the eagle's.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who satisfies your desires with good things so that your youth is renewed like the eagle's.

declarations.text: Joy springs up in my heart because God put it there and nothing can take it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You make known to me the path of life; you will fill me with joy in your presence, with eternal pleasures at your right hand.

declarations.text: My mouth is filled with praise — God's glory is always on my lips.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My mouth is filled with your praise, declaring your splendor all day long.

declarations.text: I radiate divine joy that the world cannot manufacture or contain.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord has done great things for us, and we are filled with joy.

declarations.text: Thanksgiving overflows from my soul when I remember what the Lord has done.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Enter his gates with thanksgiving and his courts with praise; give thanks to him and praise his name.

declarations.text: I dance with holy delight before the Lord — uninhibited, unashamed, and fully alive in the joy of His presence.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let them praise his name with dancing and make music to him with timbrel and harp.

declarations.text: Divine wisdom illuminates my path — God's light shows me every step, every decision, every turn I need to make.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your word is a lamp for my feet, a light on my path.

declarations.text: I hear God's voice clearly — I know my Shepherd's voice and I follow it without confusion or hesitation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he is our God and we are the people of his pasture, the flock under his care. Today, if only you would hear his voice.

declarations.text: My steps are ordered by the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord, and He delights in his way.

declarations.text: Perfect guidance leads me always — the Holy Spirit is my counselor and God's Word lights my way.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will instruct you and teach you in the way you should go; I will counsel you with my loving eye on you.

declarations.text: I walk in divine revelation — God opens my eyes to see what others miss and my understanding deepens.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Send me your light and your faithful care, let them lead me; let them bring me to your holy mountain, to the place where you dwell.

declarations.text: Through God I push back every enemy and overthrow every opposing force.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Through you we push back our enemies; through your name we trample our foes.

declarations.text: Every chain that has held me is broken — the resurrection of Jesus shattered every shackle and I walk free.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He brought them out of darkness, the utter darkness, and broke away their chains.

declarations.text: Freedom is my inheritance as a child of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will walk about in freedom, for I have sought out your precepts.

declarations.text: I triumph over every enemy through the One who loved me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With God we will gain the victory, and he will trample down our enemies.

declarations.text: Deliverance comes swiftly when I call on the name of the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from my foes, who were too strong for me.

declarations.text: My faith moves mountains — I serve the God of the impossible.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Those who trust in the Lord are like Mount Zion, which cannot be shaken but endures forever.

declarations.text: I trust completely in God's timing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My times are in your hands; deliver me from the hands of my enemies, from those who pursue me.

declarations.text: When I am afraid I trust God and that faith transforms fear.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When I am afraid, I put my trust in you.

declarations.text: My confidence is unshakeable — not in myself, but in the God who never fails.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Though an army besiege me, my heart will not fear; though war break out against me, even then I will be confident.

declarations.text: I walk by faith and not by sight.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For I have always been mindful of your unfailing love and have lived in reliance on your faithfulness.

declarations.text: Unfailing love surrounds me on every side — I am wrapped in God's covenant love.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Many are the woes of the wicked, but the Lord's unfailing love surrounds the one who trusts in him.

declarations.text: I am the beloved of God — chosen before creation, known before birth, loved with an everlasting and unshakeable love.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Save us and help us with your right hand, that those you love may be delivered.

declarations.text: Divine favor opens every door I need — God goes before me and makes the crooked places straight.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely, Lord, you bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

declarations.text: Mercy triumphs in my life over every accusation and every failure.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But from everlasting to everlasting the Lord's love is with those who fear him, and his righteousness with their children's children.

declarations.text: I am crowned with God's lovingkindness and tender mercies.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who redeems your life from the pit and crowns you with love and compassion.

declarations.text: I am fearfully and wonderfully made — this is God's own declaration about His workmanship, and I receive it fully.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made; your works are wonderful, I know that full well.

declarations.text: I am a child of the King — adopted into the royal family, carrying His nature.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I said, 'You are gods; you are all sons of the Most High.'

declarations.text: I am God's masterpiece — created in Christ Jesus for good works designed specifically for me before time began.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For you created my inmost being; you knit me together in my mother's womb. I praise you because I am fearfully and wonderfully made.

declarations.text: Purpose and destiny guide my steps.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will vindicate me; your love, Lord, endures forever do not abandon the works of your hands.

declarations.text: I am chosen and appointed by Jesus to go and bear lasting fruit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those you choose and bring near to live in your courts! We are filled with the good things of your house, of your holy temple.

declarations.text: Divine light illuminates every dark place in my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You, Lord, keep my lamp burning; my God turns my darkness into light.

declarations.text: I shine with the glory of heaven.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Those who look to him are radiant; their faces are never covered with shame.

declarations.text: The truth of God's Word has set me free.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have chosen the way of faithfulness; I have set my heart on your laws.

declarations.text: I walk in the light as He is in the light.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Blessed are those who have learned to acclaim you, who walk in the light of your presence, Lord.

declarations.text: Revelation flows to me freely — God opens the eyes of my heart and shows me things that change everything.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The unfolding of your words gives light; it gives understanding to the simple.

declarations.text: The Lord rewards me according to Christ's perfect record applied to my account.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord has dealt with me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands he has rewarded me.

declarations.text: Holiness is not a burden I carry but a beauty I wear in God's presence.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Your statutes, Lord, stand firm; holiness adorns your house for endless days.

declarations.text: I walk in divine justice — the Lord is a God of justice and He makes right every injustice.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He will make your righteous reward shine like the dawn, your vindication like the noonday sun.

declarations.text: My heart is pure before God — washed clean by His mercy and kept clean by His Spirit.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The one who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not trust in an idol or swear by a false god.

declarations.text: I stand blameless and complete in Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have been blameless before him and have kept myself from sin.

declarations.text: The Lord is faithful to all His promises over my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is trustworthy in all he promises and faithful in all he does.

declarations.text: I inherit the kingdom of God as His child and His heir.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the meek will inherit the land and enjoy peace and prosperity.

declarations.text: The Lord withholds no good thing from those who walk with integrity.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the Lord God is a sun and shield; the Lord bestows favor and honor; no good thing does he withhold from those whose walk is blameless.

declarations.text: I possess the land of promise — I step into every inheritance God declared over me and I claim it fully.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For those who are evil will be destroyed, but those who hope in the Lord will inherit the land.

declarations.text: Heaven's treasures are laid up for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Wealth and riches are in their houses, and their righteousness endures forever.

declarations.text: I dwell in God's presence continually — His nearness is my home.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely the righteous will praise your name, and the upright will live in your presence.

declarations.text: The Holy Spirit lives in me — His power and presence are mine.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not cast me from your presence or take your Holy Spirit from me.

declarations.text: I commune with the Divine — God hears me and I hear Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul pants for you, my God. My soul thirsts for God, for the living God.

declarations.text: God's presence goes before me — I am never walking alone.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You hem me in behind and before, and you lay your hand upon me.

declarations.text: I am never alone — God is with me wherever I go.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Where can I go from your Spirit? Where can I flee from your presence? If I go up to the heavens, you are there; if I make my bed in the depths, you are there.

declarations.text: I exercise divine authority in Jesus' name.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You made them rulers over the works of your hands; you put everything under their feet.

declarations.text: Power belongs to God — and He has chosen to release that power through me, His vessel.
declarations.bibleVerseText: One thing God has spoken, two things I have heard: Power belongs to you, God.

declarations.text: I rejoice in God's strength — His might is my source of confidence and victory.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The king rejoices in your strength, Lord. How great is his joy in the victories you give!

declarations.text: Dominion is my birthright as an image-bearer of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You made them rulers over the works of your hands; you put everything under their feet: all flocks and herds, and the animals of the wild, the birds in the sky, and the fish in the sea.

declarations.text: I decree a thing and it is established for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he spoke, and it came to be; he commanded, and it stood firm.

declarations.text: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.

declarations.text: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.

declarations.text: I lift my eyes to the mountains; my help comes from the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I lift up my eyes to the mountains where does my help come from? My help comes from the Lord, the Maker of heaven and earth.

declarations.text: The Lord watches over my coming and going, now and forever.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.

declarations.text: I am still and I know that He is God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He says, 'Be still, and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted in the earth.'

declarations.text: The Lord is my light and salvation and I do not fear.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my light and my salvation whom shall I fear? The Lord is the stronghold of my life of whom shall I be afraid?

declarations.text: God is my refuge and strength, always ready to help in times of trouble.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

declarations.text: I am like a tree planted by water, yielding fruit in every season.
declarations.bibleVerseText: That person is like a tree planted by streams of water, which yields its fruit in season and whose leaf does not wither whatever they do prospers.

declarations.text: The Lord forgives all my sins and heals all my diseases.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who forgives all your sins and heals all your diseases.

declarations.text: The Lord redeems my life and crowns me with love and compassion.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who redeems your life from the pit and crowns you with love and compassion.

declarations.text: God has created a clean heart in me and renewed a right spirit within me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Create in me a pure heart, O God, and renew a steadfast spirit within me.

declarations.text: Weeping may endure for a night, but joy comes in the morning.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime; weeping may stay for the night, but rejoicing comes in the morning.

declarations.text: I have set the Lord always before me; I shall not be moved.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I keep my eyes always on the Lord. With him at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

declarations.text: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and all that is within me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Praise the Lord, my soul; all my inmost being, praise his holy name.

declarations.text: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me.

declarations.text: God called me into this room — and the One who calls never sends people unprepared.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The one who calls you is faithful, and he will do it.

declarations.text: God is already working in me for this exact moment — I don't walk in here alone.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For it is God who works in you to will and to act in order to fulfill his good purpose.

declarations.text: I already have God's approval — what's in this room cannot add to or take from that.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Am I now trying to win the approval of human beings, or of God? Or am I trying to please people? If I were still trying to please people, I would not be a servant of Christ.

declarations.text: God is with me in this room — His presence is all the preparation I need.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Have I not commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Do not be afraid; do not be discouraged, for the Lord your God will be with you wherever you go.

declarations.text: I was made to carry light into exactly this kind of room — shrinking was never the plan.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You are the light of the world. A town built on a hill cannot be hidden.

declarations.text: The Spirit of God lives in me — He is greater than every voice saying I don't belong here.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.

declarations.text: God chose the unlikely on purpose — I am exactly the kind of person He does His work through.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong.

declarations.text: I don't need every answer — the One who has them all is walking into this room with me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.

declarations.text: God already walked into this room before me — He is here, and He made a way.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord himself goes before you and will be with you; he will never leave you nor forsake you.

declarations.text: I have been with Jesus — and that changes everything people see when they look at me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When they saw the courage of Peter and John and realized that they were unschooled, ordinary men, they were astonished and they took note that these men had been with Jesus.

declarations.text: I walk by faith today and not by what I see with my eyes.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we live by faith, not by sight.

declarations.text: I have the faith of a mustard seed, and I can move mountains.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Truly I tell you, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move.

declarations.text: I am confident that all things are possible for me because I believe.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Everything is possible for one who believes.

declarations.text: I am fully persuaded that God is able to do what He has promised.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Being fully persuaded that God had power to do what he had promised.

declarations.text: I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave Himself for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The life I now live in the body, I live by faith in the Son of God.

declarations.text: I shield myself with faith, which stops every attack of the enemy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In addition to all this, take up the shield of faith, with which you can extinguish all the flaming arrows of the evil one.

declarations.text: My faith rises as I hear the Word of God and act on what I hear.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Consequently, faith comes from hearing the message, and the message is heard through the word about Christ.

declarations.text: I am an overcomer because my faith gives me the victory over the world.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For everyone born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world, even our faith.

declarations.text: I please God by trusting Him with my whole heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And without faith it is impossible to please God.

declarations.text: I ask in bold faith and receive abundantly from the hand of the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But when you ask, you must believe and not doubt.

declarations.text: I am justified by faith and I have peace with God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith, we have peace with God.

declarations.text: I am a child of God through faith in Christ Jesus.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So in Christ Jesus you are all children of God through faith.

declarations.text: I receive what I pray for because I believe that I have already received it.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.

declarations.text: I stand firm in my faith, courageous and unshaken in the face of every storm.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be on your guard; stand firm in the faith; be courageous; be strong.

declarations.text: I am saved by grace through faith, and it is a gift from God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God.

declarations.text: I hold fast to the confession of my faith without wavering.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for he who promised is faithful.

declarations.text: My faith grows stronger through every trial and God is producing something great in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Because you know that the testing of your faith produces perseverance.

declarations.text: I have the faith to be healed and I am made whole.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He said to her, 'Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace.'

declarations.text: I am looking unto Jesus, the author and finisher of my faith.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Fixing our eyes on Jesus, the pioneer and perfecter of faith.

declarations.text: I live by faith, and I am the righteous one in God's eyes.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The righteous will live by their faith.

declarations.text: I have the faith that moves God to act on my behalf.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralyzed man, 'Son, your sins are forgiven.'

declarations.text: I don't need to see it to believe it — my faith is the evidence.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now faith is confidence in what we hope for and assurance about what we do not see.

declarations.text: When everything in my circumstances says no, my faith says God already said yes.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For no matter how many promises God has made, they are 'Yes' in Christ.

declarations.text: I am fully persuaded: the God who raised Jesus from the dead is not finished with my situation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He was fully persuaded that God had power to do what he had promised.

declarations.text: My faith rests not in my own strength but in the faithfulness of a God who cannot lie.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If we are faithless, he remains faithful, for he cannot disown himself.

declarations.text: Like Abraham I call things that are not as though they are and speak life over every dead place.
declarations.bibleVerseText: ...the God who gives life to the dead and calls into being things that were not.

declarations.text: My faith grows stronger every time God's Word rises above my feelings.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In the same way, faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by action, is dead.

declarations.text: I bring the impossible before God and watch faith turn it into testimony.
declarations.bibleVerseText: With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.

declarations.text: My faith anchors me to God right in the middle of the storm.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

declarations.text: I walk in the righteousness of God through faith in Christ Jesus and I am already approved.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own that comes from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ.

declarations.text: God loves me most powerfully not when I have it together but when I don't.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.'

declarations.text: I receive a constant flow of blessings and favor that I did not have to earn.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Out of his fullness we have all received grace in place of grace already given.

declarations.text: I can talk to God with total confidence because He is always ready to help me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let us then approach God's throne of grace with confidence, so that we may receive mercy and find grace to help us in our time of need.

declarations.text: Everything good in me is Christ working through me by grace and His life is the source of all.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By the grace of God I am what I am, and his grace to me was not without effect.

declarations.text: God has forgiven every failure and given me a completely new beginning.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And all are justified freely by his grace through the redemption that came by Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: No matter how much I mess up God has even more love and grace for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But where sin increased, grace increased all the more.

declarations.text: I am saved by grace — a gift from God that no human effort could ever buy or earn.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God.

declarations.text: I am free from guilt and shame because God's grace is now in charge of my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For sin shall no longer be your master, because you are not under the law, but under grace.

declarations.text: God chose me and called me to do great things before I was even born.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But when God, who set me apart from my mother's womb and called me by his grace, was pleased to reveal his Son in me.

declarations.text: God gives me more than enough of everything I need to do good work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.

declarations.text: His yoke is easy and His burden is light — He carries every weight alongside me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.

declarations.text: I lead from overflow, not exhaustion, because God is my source and rest is my foundation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Not by might nor by power, but by my Spirit, says the Lord Almighty.

declarations.text: My mistakes do not stop me because God always helps me get back on my feet.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory in Christ, after you have suffered a little while, will himself restore you.

declarations.text: I am strong in the grace of Christ Jesus and grace carries me through every challenge.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You then, my son, be strong in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I stand before God fully accepted, clothed in the righteousness of Christ, not my own.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To the praise of the glory of His grace, by which He made us accepted in the Beloved.

declarations.text: My whole life is a story that shows everyone how kind and good God is.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I consider my life worth nothing to me... the task of testifying to the good news of God's grace.

declarations.text: New doors open for me because God's favor is like a shield all around me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For you, Lord, bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

declarations.text: I no longer carry the shame of my past — Christ took it all and I am free.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

declarations.text: I am being transformed not by trying harder but by beholding Him and being changed from glory to glory.
declarations.bibleVerseText: We all... are being transformed into his image with ever-increasing glory.

declarations.text: God's goodness and love pursue me faithfully every single day of my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life.

declarations.text: I don't have to earn my place at the table — grace already seated me there.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he chose us in him before the creation of the world.

declarations.text: When I am most aware of my weakness, I am in the place where grace does its best work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But he said to me, 'My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.'

declarations.text: Grace is not permission to stay stuck but the power to become who God always saw me as.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For the grace of God has appeared that offers salvation to all people. It teaches us to say 'No' to ungodliness.

declarations.text: I receive grace upon grace and an endless supply covers every gap, every failure, and every lack.
declarations.bibleVerseText: From his fullness we have all received, grace upon grace.

declarations.text: My biggest mess became God's greatest message — that is exactly what grace does.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him.

declarations.text: I walk in the riches of God's grace where every debt is cancelled and every sin is fully forgiven.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In him we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins, in accordance with the riches of God's grace.

declarations.text: I am justified by His grace and I live as a full heir of every promise He has made.
declarations.bibleVerseText: So that, having been justified by his grace, we might become heirs having the hope of eternal life.

declarations.text: Grace is the firm foundation of everything I am — not my effort, not my performance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I do not set aside the grace of God, for if righteousness could be gained through the law, Christ died for nothing.

declarations.text: I live under grace and not under the weight of works because grace is the ground I stand on.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And if by grace, then it cannot be based on works; if it were, grace would no longer be grace.

declarations.text: I receive the grace of God fully and let it produce everything He intended in my life.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As God's co-workers we urge you not to receive God's grace in vain.

declarations.text: I sleep in peace every night because God alone is my safety and my shelter.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In peace I will lie down and sleep, for you alone, Lord, make me dwell in safety.

declarations.text: My heavy burdens belong to God — He has given my soul the rest I was made for.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

declarations.text: I am still. The Lord is fighting for me and I don't have to do anything but rest.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will fight for you; you need only to be still.

declarations.text: I have a peace that makes no sense to the world because God is guarding my heart.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And the peace of God, which transcends all understanding, will guard your hearts and your minds.

declarations.text: In quiet rest before the Lord, strength rises up in me without any striving.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In repentance and rest is your salvation, in quietness and trust is your strength.

declarations.text: I am led by the Spirit to a place of quietness and total refreshment.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters, he refreshes my soul.

declarations.text: God holds every anxious thought — He cares for every detail of my life and I am at peace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

declarations.text: I live in the shadow of the Almighty where no harm can ever reach me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

declarations.text: I trust God to provide for me even while I am resting.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In vain you rise early and stay up late... for he grants sleep to those he loves.

declarations.text: My mind is set on God and He keeps me in perfect peace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will keep in perfect peace those whose minds are steadfast, because they trust in you.

declarations.text: My true rest is in God alone — He is the source of all my hope.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Yes, my soul, find rest in God; my hope comes from him.

declarations.text: I walk through the day with a calm heart because God is right beside me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

declarations.text: God's rest is already mine — His promises are true and I am completely at peace.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Now we who have believed enter that rest.

declarations.text: God's mercy is new every morning — the past is gone and I am held in His love today.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Because of the Lord's great love we are not consumed... his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.

declarations.text: I am like a child resting safely in the arms of a loving Father.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But I have calmed and quieted myself, I am like a weaned child with its mother.

declarations.text: The peace of God rules my heart and guides every step I take.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let the peace of Christ rule in your hearts, since as members of one body you were called to peace.

declarations.text: God is my strength and my shield — rest is not weakness, it is trust in Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in him, and he helps me.

declarations.text: I enter the Sabbath rest God has prepared for His people and receive the renewal that only He can give.
declarations.bibleVerseText: There remains, then, a Sabbath-rest for the people of God.

declarations.text: Being close to God fills me with deep satisfaction and rest — nothing else comes close.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will fill me with joy in your presence, with eternal pleasures at your right hand.

declarations.text: God has already given me peace and nothing can take it away from me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord gives strength to his people; the Lord blesses his people with peace.

declarations.text: I rest in the fact that God is for me and nothing can stand against me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: What, then, shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

declarations.text: God's goodness is the last thing on my mind each night and I rest deeply in His love.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Return to your rest, my soul, for the Lord has been good to you.

declarations.text: The weight I was never meant to carry is already gone — His yoke is lighter than I ever imagined.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.

declarations.text: I work from a place of rest and not rest from a place of exhaustion.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In repentance and rest is your salvation, in quietness and trust is your strength.

declarations.text: In the stillness, God has been speaking all along — my soul is at rest and I can hear Him.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be still, and know that I am God.

declarations.text: Even when life is loud and my mind is racing I carry a secret place of peace within me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

declarations.text: I dwell in the rest of God where striving ceases and His strength sustains me through every season.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But those who hope in the Lord will renew their strength. They will soar on wings like eagles; they will run and not grow weary, they will walk and not be faint.

declarations.text: I am still in my spirit and that stillness is where God speaks loudest.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When you lie down, you will not be afraid; when you lie down, your sleep will be sweet.

declarations.text: My peace is not dependent on my circumstances but anchored in the unchanging faithfulness of God.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.

declarations.text: I rest deeply because God loves me, keeps me, and is never finished working on my behalf.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord your God is with you, the Mighty Warrior who saves. He will take great delight in you; in his love he will no longer rebuke you, but will rejoice over you with singing.
